transcript.answer: Pull request #475 in re-cinq/Otto, "Hand the resolved fallback to HAL Engine, and refuse fallbacks it cannot serve". It was merged on 2026-10-23 and closes issue #474. Before it, #179 (PR #438) only checked FALLBACK_MODEL_ID against the allowlist and printed it in the api.model startup line. buildEngine never passed any fallbackProviders, which is the only setting HAL Engine fails over through. PR #475 added supportAgentProviders(config) in apps/api/src/server.ts. It returns the resolved fallback as fallbackProviders, or [] when FALLBACK_MODEL_ID is unset, and buildEngine spreads it into createHalEngine. It also made startup refuse non-mock fallbacks.
